title: Design System: University Church of the Nazarene

shadows.name: shared-header
shadows.purpose: Separate the fixed shared navigation from page content.

motion.name: home-horizon-arrive
motion.purpose: Reveal the hero horizon line once; disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Homepage primary action
components.description: Gold pill action for the hero's primary next step.
components.css: .home-page .hero-actions .btn { min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0.85rem 1.45rem; border: 1px solid #D39512; border-radius: 999px; background: #D39512; color: #000000; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; } .home-page .hero-actions .btn:hover { background: #e5ae38; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Homepage secondary action
components.description: Outlined white pill action used beside the primary hero action.
components.css: .home-page .hero-actions .btn + .btn { border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.66); background: transparent; color: #FFFFFF; } .home-page .hero-actions .btn + .btn:hover { border-color: #FFFFFF; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); }

narrative.overview: The public site pairs the church's established Georgia typography and brand palette with a calm editorial layout. The homepage moves from a dark horizon into warm paper surfaces, guiding visitors through the church's published content. Use the real church logo and Supabase-managed content as the source of truth; generous spacing and clear headings carry the experience.
keyCharacteristics: Brand color used sparingly against dark, white, and warm-paper surfaces.
Flat editorial sections, thin dividers, and rounded actions.
Homepage content and visibility remain administrator-editable.

rules.name: The Dawn-to-Day Rule
rules.body: Keep the dark horizon in the welcome; let the rest of the homepage remain light, readable, and content-led.

dos: Use the exact church brand colors.
Preserve the logo, shared navigation and footer, Supabase rendering, and admin editability.
Respect responsive spacing, visible focus, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Do not restore the removed homepage callout or its dedicated fields.
Do not hardcode or republish Supabase-managed content to make a section appear.
Do not add colored glow shadows to homepage actions.
